wrap_type_patch_class: wrap a Python class by patching its methods and properties to intercept calls via __torch_function__
py_wrap_method_intercept: create a Python wrapper that intercepts method calls and routes them through __torch_function__
wrap_attr_property: wrap a property getter so its access is intercepted through the __torch_function__ hook
review_FUNC_TYPES: review the FUNC_TYPES tuple that defines which callable types get wrapped during type patching
review_PROPERTY_TYPES: review the PROPERTY_TYPES tuple that defines which descriptor types get wrapped as properties
